name: Eternal Tether
source:
Part four is dedicated to US intelligence officer and undercover assassin Mars meeting his old friend and now colleague from the agency Clive Smith. Clive has tender feelings about Mars.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
第四部分讲述了美国情报官员和卧底刺客马尔斯与他的老朋友、现任克莱夫·史密斯机构的同事的会面。克莱夫对火星怀有温柔的感情。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
